historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved, as amended, the conditional use authorization to demolish the existing single-family dwelling at 3953 24th Street and construct a four-story mixed-use building with six senior dwelling units and two commercial units.
An existing single-family dwelling stood at 3953 24th Street.
